task.title: Step 04: TEST-DESIGNER writes test spec for GBL-116 bench pre-flight fix
task.description: Write a test spec for the GBL-116 bench pre-flight fix. The fix changed behavior of `zig build bench` and `zig build test-env-verify` (the env-verify C6 stale-locks check). The spec must cover: (1) what the new env-verify gate assertions should be; (2) what the bench pre-flight smoke test should assert; (3) explicit negative test for the post-condition check (run migrate against a DB where the pre-flight was deliberately skipped → must fail loudly). The integration test file already exists at tests/integration/iss0706_gbl116_bench_preflight_test.zig (already written by Step 03); THIS step is about formalizing the spec at tests/specs/iss-0706-gbl116-bench-pre-flight.md for traceability to requirements. IMPORTANT: the actual Zig test source MUST NOT be edited (it was already authored by Step 03 BACKEND-DEV). This step is documentation-only.
